**Thread**: [thread](./13-10-21.thread.md#:~:text=2006/03/06/13-10-21)

Entries may be added to the config file as follows:

[format]
         headers = "Organization: CodeWeavers\nTo: wine-patches 
<wine-patches@winehq.org>\n"
